messages.subject: [Rprotobuf-yada] RProtoBuf 0.4.7
messages.body_plain:
Earlier this well CRAN had asked that all references to

     omegahat.org

be replaced with

     omegahat.net

We had two (2) in, respectively, a code comment (!!) and a bib file. Sigh.

But no point arguing so I shipped it.  Made one or two more minor tweaks to
README.md and DESCRIPTION.

Dirk
